title: Mistune: Quadratic-time DoS in parse_link_href via unbounded parenthesis scan on empty-label links (CVE-2026-97698)
description: Mistune versions prior to 3.3.4 contain a quadratic-time denial-of-service vulnerability in the parse_link_href function. This occurs due to an unbounded parenthesis scan triggered by empty-label links, causing excessive CPU usage when rendering crafted markdown inputs. The issue is fixed in version 3.3.4.
